title: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan heist drama 12 12 12 arrives on Apple TV
summary: The eight-part thriller tells the story of a robbery across three timelines.
body:
12 12 12, a new heist drama starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, has started on Apple TV. The first two episodes are available now, with a new one each week until 25 December.

The eight-part series tells its story across three timelines: the 12 months spent planning a robbery, the 12 hours of the heist itself, and the 12 days that follow.

Who is in it

Mackie and Dornan are also executive producers. The cast includes Jack Kesy, Agathe Rousselle, Kali Reis and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson.

The series was created by Jim Keeble and Dudi Appleton.

Sources: Apple TV, Collider, 9to5Mac.
